src: data as of Nov 1, ~21:00 UTC · sources: TokenPost, crypto.news, CryptoTicker, SoSoValue (TokenPost), 24/7 Wall St, Newsquawk · not financial advice

beats.say: Binance reopened Bitcoin withdrawals after a six point three billion dollar hack. Bitcoin sits near seventy-eight thousand.
beats.cap: Binance reopened BTC withdrawals after a $6.3B hack. BTC sits near $78K.

beats.say: Ether is up under half a percent. Solana slips one point four percent, near ninety-four.
A quiet Sunday: fifty-six million liquidated, about six in ten longs.
Bitcoin ETFs lost six hundred forty-three million Friday, the most in a day since June.
beats.cap: BTC ETFs −$643M Friday, the most in a day since June.

beats.say: The driver: Binance says about ninety-five percent of the hacked assets are now replenished.
beats.cap: The driver: Binance says ~95% of hacked assets are replenished.

beats.say: This week: I S M today, U S midterms Tuesday, jobs report Friday.
beats.cap: This week: ISM today, US midterms Tuesday, jobs report Friday.

beats.say: Levels to watch: eighty thousand above, last week's low near seventy-six thousand three hundred below.
beats.cap: Levels to watch: $80K above, last week's low ~$76.3K below.

title: Binance reopens withdrawals after $6.3B hack: Bitcoin near $78K, BTC ETFs -$643M
caption:
binance reopened btc withdrawals after the $6.3b hack and says ~95% of affected assets are replenished 🔓 btc near $77.9k, eth $2,264, sol $94. $56m liquidated in 24h (mostly longs). btc etfs -$643m friday, worst day since late june. this week: ism today, us midterms tue, jobs report fri. not financial advice.
